uses.quote: Artificial Intelligence tools (AI) can be helpful for generating and synthesising ideas about topics.
They can also help you with the writing process, for example by providing feedback on written work or help with grammar and spelling.

If you are considering using Artificial Intelligence (AI) for proof-reading support, make sure to consult the LSHTM Artificial Intelligence in assessments resource first to learn what types of usage are permitted.
uses.anchor: B.1. Proof-reading and advice from others

uses.quote: Personation is the deliberate submission of work done by another person or technology (e.g. another student, a friend, a relative, a peer, a tutor, or anyone else, including generative AI and translation software) as if it were one’s own.

duty.quote: Always remember that, whilst you may use AI to assist you, you must declare this.

referencing.quote: You must cite AI tools and include them in your reference list.
